sentence: This project studies how a hydrogel-based platform can help tumor-specific T cells expand in the body for adoptive cell therapy.
This project studies how healthcare-associated infections spread in healthcare environments so that outbreaks can be detected and prevented.
This project develops a gene-silencing treatment for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, a chronic lung disease, and tests it in mouse and human models.
This project combines bioinformatic and experimental methods to study genetic variations that change gene expression and contribute to Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies how immune cells shape cancer development and looks for ways to improve cancer immunotherapy.
This project tries to find out which genetic and cellular factors guide melanocyte regeneration, using human melanocyte stem cells and the zebrafish system.
This project uses Drosophila models of Smith-Kingsmore Syndrome to study how variants affect circadian clock function and mitochondrial homeostasis in the brain.
This project tries to find out how the autophagy machinery identifies the cellular contents that it selectively eliminates.
This project uses machine learning on electronic health records to diagnose abdominal aortic aneurysm and improve screening strategies.
This project studies how liver cells called hepatocytes normally break down fat stores called lipid droplets for energy.
This project studies how a cancer-associated protein suppresses T cell responses in the tumor microenvironment and tests antibodies that block it.
This project uses machine learning to predict how peptides bind and cause immune responses, to improve cancer vaccine design for melanoma.
This project tries to find out what orphan mitochondrial proteins do and how they take part in disease-related processes.
This project uses machine learning to find and describe brain regions in the brainstem that control orofacial behaviors such as breathing, swallowing and chewing.
This project holds a conference on how cellular metabolism affects immune function in myeloid and lymphoid cells.
This project studies how solute transporters and small molecules regulate ion channels and how ion channels work in health and disease.
This project builds machine learning models that remove noise from live fluorescence images taken at faster frame rates.
This project develops assessments to describe restricted and repetitive behaviors in autism spectrum disorder.
